source: AI Image Skill Catalog - negative prompt engineering data
policy: Negative prompts suppress defect classes. They must never be used to remove desirable detail, and they are always combined with a short, targeted list rather than a long generic dump.

style.label: Style drift
style.note: Only use when the target is photographic; these tokens actively fight illustration targets.

light.guidance: Use only when a defect is actually present in the reference.

balanced.guidance: Default. Group by defect class, one clause per class.

strong.guidance: Use sparingly; long negatives fight positive detail and can produce flat images.

artifact_signatures.signal: repeated limb shapes at the frame edge
artifact_signatures.fix: reduce subject count, raise CFG, regenerate with a pose reference

artifact_signatures.signal: letterforms that are individually plausible but not readable as a word
hard vertical or horizontal discontinuity every 512 px
artifact_signatures.fix: reduce control strength, check for latent tiling

artifact_signatures.signal: bright rim hugging an extracted subject
artifact_signatures.fix: decontaminate the matte, shrink the mask by 2-4 px

artifact_signatures.signal: visible contour steps in smooth gradients
artifact_signatures.fix: add fine grain, export as 16-bit or apply dithering

artifact_signatures.signal: large regions of pure 255 in specular areas
artifact_signatures.fix: lower exposure by 0.3-0.7 EV, raise diffusion precision
remove the duplicated noun from the prompt or use a regional prompt
